ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white field spanning both lobes. Extensive vertical tan-colored linear mottling distributed across the inner and outer regions. Continuous thick black pigmentation band along the trailing edge and lobe tips. Dark, complex pixel cluster localized at the median notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 105 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 15 percent of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular macro-serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable large concave indentation located approximately one-third inward from the left tip. Frequent small-amplitude peaks create a jagged texture along the black boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges sweeping upwards to sharp, slightly tapered and textured fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density dark clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes consistent with barnacle colonization. Scattered small circular dark spots on the white surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical tan/yellow linear streaks across both lobes. Distinct dark horizontal and diagonal linear disruptions present on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive callosity-like texture and dark pigmentation at the extreme outer tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive yellow-tan surface staining covering approximately 40 percent of the white ventral area, primarily in vertical orientations.
